caption: The video captures a clear rounded cylindrical glass resting on a pale marbled surface against a uniform blue backdrop, with a faint reflection of its base beneath it. The glass is already largely filled with white milk, topped by a foamy surface, and a continuous stream pours in from above at a diagonal angle near the rim. The stream remains active throughout. As the pour continues, the milk level creeps upward only very gradually, staying near the upper portion of the glass. The foam mound right of the entry point slowly deforms, softening and blending into the surrounding surface line. The milk surface also shows a soft crest and small bubbles along the left side. The stream column remains largely steady, with only subtle changes in angle and thickness. The glass, background, and surface appear stable, while the ongoing changes are in the fluid. The pouring continues without a visible conclusion.
